on_shelf.label: Philosophy of Right §227
on_shelf.text: They may have the right to present themselves in person before the court (in judicio stare), but of what use is that, if they are not present as intelligent spirits 'i The justice, which they receive, remains for them an. external fate. In the civic community the idea is lost in particularity, and dispersed by the separation of inner and outer.

on_shelf.ref: The Greek World, The Wars with the Persians
on_shelf.text: The antagonism of Athens and Sparta now commences— a favourite theme for historical treatment. It may be asserted that it is an idle inquiry, which of these two states justly claims the superiority, and that the endeavour should rather be, to exhibit each as in its own department a necessary and worthy phase of the Greek Spirit.
